sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Deterministic validation is invalid because the two generated shape IRIs are unknown terms in the canonical nltl namespace. Replace nltl:GeneratedI2_001ShipShape and nltl:GeneratedI2_001ApplicableShipShape with blank-node shapes or non-vocabulary shape identifiers, while retaining the supplied canonical nltl:ship and nltl:constructionContractDate terms, ship targeting, xsd:date presence, and the on-or-after 2021-01-01 applicability gate.
